newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 24.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL
-------- COMMENTS - Bunkers were thinly talked as some majors said they were out of January supplies while the remaining sellers were not quoting as they found prices too low.

After Thursday's flurry of enquiries, demand was thin, traders said. But one major said it sold 380-cst at $104, MDO at $193 and gas oil at $203. Independents who still had supplies where heard at $100-$102. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
